Share widgets as a QR code or a link that holds the whole widget, and open shared widgets straight in the launcher. Before you add one, it shows what the widget installs, every command it runs and what looks risky, and can hand it to your agent to review first. Your agent can check a widget for API keys and anything personal before you share it. Your own widgets can go to the widget store without a GitHub account. The store's refresh and back buttons are now icons.
